theorems.name: Submission.dimred_regular_point_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (y : Euclid P), IsOpen U → y ∈ regularSet T → ∃ (m : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ), 1 ≤ m ∧ 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ z ∈ T.support ∩ ball y ρ, HasMassDensity T z m
